candidate.mistake_reason: It incorrectly concluded that the process was in a loop and pivoted to using FileSurfer to open a non-existent local PDF instead of continuing with WebSurfer to scroll and read the already opened online PDF.
candidate.first_mistake: Up to step 14 the workflow was correct and the PDF was open; the next needed action was to scroll/read it. The Orchestrator prematurely changed tools at step 16, derailing the viable path to extract the word.
candidate.mistake_not_corrected: Subsequent steps kept trying FileSurfer (resulting in 404 errors) and never returned to WebSurfer to read the article, so the correct word was never found and the conversation ended with the wrong guess.

confidences.reason: The log shows that after instructing WebSurfer to scroll the already opened online PDF (Step 14), the Orchestrator immediately marked the process as being in a loop and switched to FileSurfer at Step 16 without any WebSurfer response or evidence of looping. It then tried to open a non-existent local file (file:///workspace/76.pdf), which failed with 404. The appropriate action would have been to continue with WebSurfer to read/scroll the online PDF. Therefore, the claim correctly identifies a mistake at Step 16.

Up to step 14 the team had correctly identified the journal (Fafnir), opened the exact PDF, and instructed WebSurfer to scroll/read it. There was no indication of an error at that point, and WebSurfer had not yet responded. At step 16, the Orchestrator incorrectly concluded a loop/error and switched to FileSurfer to open a local file that had not been downloaded, resulting in 404s and derailing the viable path. This appears to be the first decisive mistake that led away from simply reading the opened PDF to find the word.

After step 16, the orchestrator switched to FileSurfer and repeatedly tried (steps 17, 21, 23) to open a local PDF, resulting in 404 errors. It never returned to WebSurfer to continue reading/scrolling the already opened article (no response to step 14). The session then ended with a wrong guess ('tricksy'), so the mistake was not corrected later.
The agent at step 16 is 'Orchestrator (thought)', not the candidate 'Orchestrator'.
